allow_instructions: Run read-only git commands such as status, diff, log, and show inside the workspace.
Run lake build, lake test, and just docs-check or just test when working on ProofForge V2.
Run local Python self-tests under scripts/ that do not require network access.
block_instructions: Do not start Cloud Agents, use /in-cloud, /babysit, or any cloud subagent handoff.
Do not create or edit .cursor/environment.json because that configures remote cloud VMs.
Do not push to git remotes, open pull requests, or publish branches without explicit user approval.
Do not upload workspace files, secrets, or build artifacts to external cloud storage or telemetry endpoints.
Do not modify host bootstrap locks, formal evidence receipts, or supply-chain pins without an approved task freeze.
Do not read from or depend on active/ as an oracle, fallback, or compatibility entry.
